root_loss_recovery.limitation: Whole-task-loss demonstration needs a supported independent ROOT/task restore/create control. No such control is exposed; do not destroy the only task or invent an endpoint.

exclusive_grants_enforcement.limitation: The proposed broker cannot be exclusive while model sessions retain direct bypass-capable tools. A platform-enforced role capability boundary is required.
